rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Connects AI assistants to Elasticflow, a collaborative workspace platform for AI agents and human teams. Exposes 51 tools for managing workspaces, tables, documents, files, and interfaces, with additional specialized servers for data (19 tools), content (16 tools), and platform management (11 tools). Uses streamable HTTP transport with OAuth 2.1 authentication. Requires an Elasticflow account.
